{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "satisfaction_1to5",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "technical_issues", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Binary flag extracted from open response indicating technical problems; lies outside the satisfaction score and plausibly correlates with lower satisfaction."},
    {"name": "isolation_disconnection", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Themed complaint signal about isolation; a legitimate external feature carrying predictive signal without restating the focus."},
    {"name": "hands_on_learning_missing", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Content-based flag for missing hands-on learning; distinct from the outcome and plausibly predictive."},
    {"name": "engagement_complaints", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Extracted engagement-complaint signal; external predictor with plausible link to satisfaction."},
    {"name": "instruction_quality_gaps", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Flag for instruction quality issues; a genuine predictor not derived from the score itself."},
    {"name": "young_learner_struggle", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Theme about young learners struggling; external signal that may predict satisfaction."},
    {"name": "parent_stress_burden", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Parent-stress theme extracted from text; plausible predictor outside the focus variable."},
    {"name": "subject_specific_hardship", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Subject-difficulty signal from open response; legitimate external feature."},
    {"name": "negative_signals_count", "role": "leakage", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "This is a deterministic aggregate of the other negative flags; while not derived from the score itself, it is redundant with its components and is essentially a hand-built proxy for low satisfaction rather than an independent predictor. As a summed count of negative themes it borders on restating the intended target construct."},
    {"name": "predicted_low_satisfaction", "role": "leakage", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "A column literally predicting/labelling low satisfaction is a target proxy — either derived from the focus (leakage) or a restatement of the outcome to be predicted; not a valid independent feature."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 8,
  "predictive_utility": 0.65,
  "rationale": "Eight of the ten columns are theme-level binary flags mined from the open_response text (technical issues, isolation, missing hands-on learning, engagement complaints, instruction gaps, young-learner struggle, parent stress, subject hardship). These lie outside the satisfaction score, are not deterministic functions of it, and plausibly carry genuine predictive signal about low satisfaction — a solid set of engineered features. However, 'negative_signals_count' is a mechanical aggregate of the other flags (redundant and constructed to mirror the target), and 'predicted_low_satisfaction' is an explicit target proxy that leaks/restates the focus variable. Excluding those two, the set gives real, non-trivial predictive leverage beyond the original columns, hence moderate-to-good utility."
}
